# Craft — agent getting started

> Use `craft-ds@0.4.0` to build a React + Tailwind v4 website. This is the full guide. The short index is https://craft-ds.com/llms.txt

## Install

```bash
npm install craft-ds@0.4.0
```

In the stylesheet that already imports Tailwind:

```css
@import "tailwindcss";
@import "craft-ds/ds.css";
@source "../node_modules/craft-ds";
```

Adjust the `@source` path so it reaches `node_modules/craft-ds`. Vite apps that import CSS from `src/` typically use `../node_modules/craft-ds`. Without `@source`, Tailwind will not emit `type-h1` or `ds-prose` because those class names live inside the package.

Alternatively, from the project root:

```bash
pnpx craft-ds@0.4.0 init
```

That copies `ds.tsx` and `ds.css` into `components/` and injects the CSS import. Import from `@/components/ds` in that case.

## Document root

Next.js App Router:

```tsx
import { Layout } from "craft-ds/ds";

export default function RootLayout({ children }) {
  return <Layout>{children}</Layout>;
}
```

Vite or React Router — the app already has `<html>`. Do not wrap it in Craft `Layout`.

```tsx
import { root } from "craft-ds/ds";

<html lang="en" className={root}>
```

`root` is `scroll-smooth antialiased focus:scroll-auto`.

## Type

```tsx
import { typography, Prose, cn } from "craft-ds/ds";

<h1 className={typography.h1}>Settings</h1>
<p className={cn(typography.lead, typography.muted)}>Manage your workspace.</p>

<Prose isArticle isSpaced>
  <h1>Article title</h1>
  <p className="lead">Intro for markdown or CMS HTML.</p>
</Prose>
```

- UI text → `typography.*` (`h1`–`h6`, `body`, `lead`, `large`, `small`, `caption`, `muted`)
- Markdown / CMS / AI HTML → `<Prose isArticle isSpaced>`
- App chrome stays outside Prose
- Children inside Prose are plain HTML. `lead`, `large`, `small`, and `muted` are class names on that HTML.

`typography.h1` is `"type-h1 sm:type-h1-sm"`. `text-lg` will not override it — pick another role.

## Layout

```tsx
import { Nav, Main, Section, Container, typography } from "craft-ds/ds";

<Nav>{/* brand, links */}</Nav>
<Main>
  <Section>
    <Container>
      <h1 className={typography.h1}>Page title</h1>
    </Container>
  </Section>
</Main>
```

Override spacing and chrome with `className` and `cn()`. There are no variant props.

## Done when

A heading using `typography.h1` is about 48px on a desktop viewport and 36px at 390px wide. If those sizes are 16px, `@source` is missing or `ds.css` was not imported after Tailwind.
